definition: the pipes and cables a city runs on
description: In a deep trench dug under a city street at dusk, a young woman engineer in a white hard hat, an orange high-visibility jacket and work trousers climbs a ladder, holding on to a huge old riveted iron water main beside her, and looks up as she climbs. Around her the trench is crossed by more large pipes, a yellow gas pipe and bundles of black and orange cables, and an old brick sewer tunnel opens behind. Water trickles down the muddy walls, and above, cars pass on the road between lit brick buildings.

taps.phrase: to climb up from the trench
to glance up at the street
